identity.name: Expedition Gallatin
identity.one_liner: The $50 field/tactical quartz with compass bezel and Indiglo — Timex's entry in the outdoor-instrument category.

narrative.story: The Expedition Gallatin is Timex's field-and-trail watch, named for the Gallatin National Forest. The 41mm case combines a brass body with a resin overlay for impact resistance. The bidirectional compass bezel and the Indiglo backlight are the functional features. The Expedition is the most-cited Timex field watch and the watch a collector cites when they want an affordable outdoor instrument that runs on a coin-cell battery.
narrative.collector_notes: The Expedition line has been in the Timex catalogue since the 1990s. The Gallatin variant is the mid-size (41mm); the Field Expedition is smaller.
